title: 第一百五十四章 柔术练得不错，一字马劈得这么直！
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

这一腿踢得很高，脚尖超过了王大壮的头顶。

如果踢中了，普通人会被踢晕，不普通的也会被踢得眼冒金星。

王大壮没有再躲。

他抬起右手，五指张开，稳稳地抓住了她的脚踝。

孙菲菲的腿被王大壮抓在手里，身体悬空，另一条腿还站在地上，整个人呈一个标准的“一字马”姿势。

她的柔韧性好得惊人，大腿后侧的腘绳肌和内侧的内收肌群拉伸到了极致，运动裤的布料绷得紧紧的。

她坐在冰凉的地板上，右腿被王大壮高高抬起，身体的重心全部压在左腿上。

王大壮低头看着对方，目光里有意外，还有一丝哭笑不得。

“你的柔术练得不错，一字马劈得这么直，普通人根本就做不到，不去当舞蹈员兼职可惜了。”

孙菲菲的脸一下子红透了。

不是运动后气血上涌的那种红，是羞愤交加、恨不得找个地缝钻进去的那种红。

她想骂王大壮，可没有力气骂了，大口大口地喘着气，胸口剧烈地起伏着。

“放开我。”

王大壮微微一笑，顺势松开了她的脚踝。

孙菲菲刚把腿收回来要站起来，还不等站稳，王大壮的手已经搭上了她的肩头，轻轻一推，孙菲菲又坐回了地上。

她想站起来，王大壮的膝盖压在她大腿上，刚好卡在她发力的关节上，让孙菲菲怎么都站不起来。

孙菲菲气急败坏起来，双手撑在地上身体猛地一拧，双腿朝王大壮的腰侧绞去。

这是柔术中的剪刀脚，双腿夹住对方的腰部用力绞杀，能把人的肋骨绞断。

她的动作很快，发力也很猛，剪刀脚锁住了王大壮的腰，用力绞了两下。

王大壮没想到她还有这一手。身体被她绞得失去了平衡，两个人一起倒在地上，从书桌旁边滚到床脚。

他在上，她在下。

两个人的身体纠缠在一起，像两条扭打在一起麻绳，越来越紧。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

This leg kicked very high, and the toes went above Wang Dazhuang's head.

If the kick hits, ordinary people will be knocked unconscious, and extraordinary people will be kicked until stars appear in their eyes.

Wang Dazhuang didn't hide anymore.

He raised his right hand, spread his fingers, and firmly grasped her ankle.

Sun Feifei's leg was held in Wang Dazhuang's hand, her body was hanging in the air, and her other leg was still standing on the ground, with her whole body in a standard "one-word horse" posture.

Her flexibility was amazing, the hamstrings on the back of her thighs and the adductors on the inside of her thighs were stretched to the extreme, and the fabric of her sweatpants was stretched tight.

She sat on the cold floor, her right leg was lifted high by Wang Dazhuang, and all her body weight rested on her left leg.

Wang Dazhuang looked down at the other person, with surprise in his eyes and a hint of dumbfounding.

"You're very good at jujitsu. You can do such a straight split. Ordinary people can't do it. It would be a pity not to work part-time as a dancer."

Sun Feifei's face suddenly turned red.

It's not the kind of red that makes your blood surge after exercise, but the kind that makes you feel ashamed and angry, and you want to find a crack in the ground to crawl into.

She wanted to scold Wang Dazhuang, but she didn't have the strength to do so. She gasped for air and her chest heaved violently.

"Let me go."

Wang Dazhuang smiled slightly and released her ankle.

Sun Feifei just pulled her legs back to stand up, but before she could stand firmly, Wang Dazhuang's hand had already been put on her shoulders. With a gentle push, Sun Feifei sat back on the ground.

She wanted to stand up, but Wang Dazhuang's knee pressed against her thigh, which happened to be stuck on her exerting joint, making it impossible for Sun Feifei to stand up.

Sun Feifei became furious, put her hands on the ground and twisted her body violently, twisting her legs towards Wang Dazhuang's waist.

This is the scissor kick in Jiu-Jitsu. The opponent's waist is clamped with both legs and strangled hard, which can break the person's ribs.

Her movements were very fast and her force was very fierce. She locked Wang Dazhuang's waist with her scissor kicks and twisted it hard twice.

Wang Dazhuang didn't expect that she had this skill.Her body was twisted out of balance by her, and the two of them fell to the ground together, rolling from the desk to the foot of the bed.

He is on top, she is on bottom.

The bodies of the two people were entangled together, like two hemp ropes wrestling together, getting tighter and tighter.

title_en: Chapter 154: I have practiced jujitsu very well, and my horse chops are so straight!
